_note: Approved push wording. The push Worker fetches this file from GitHub Pages. Edit through a pull request only. Titles end with the star (reactions may end with their own symbol), no em dashes, no links. Placeholders: {name} is the person getting the push, {who} the friend it is about, plus {habit}, {n}, {n1}, {post}, {q}, {sky}, {answer}, {label}, {value}. A line can have several titles (titles, the first also kept in title for older Worker versions) that rotate. Lines with the same set are kept apart. rare: N means about 1 in N sends. only: tag means only people tracking that habit. Groups: A habits morning, J journaling morning, C small ritual, E evening nudge, BT brew titles, V Sunday vote, R Monday result, B sky titles, IN friend showed up, ALL all four showed up, RX reactions (tag is the reaction), QA brew answers, SR shared reads, CU Currently (tag is the field), GH new group habit, CM coven milestone (must match L_MILE in index.html), MP private milestone, ST streak at risk, CB comeback. GH, CM and CU must stay word for word and in the same order as L_GROUP, L_MILE and CUR_LINES in index.html (with {who} for {name}); tests check this. Source of truth for wording: the Spell Check copy library.
